name.description: The setting's name, e.g. 'App theme', 'Start with Windows'.

description.description: What it does, in a line.

value.description: Its current value, if it has one, e.g. 'Dark', 'English (United States)'; or a button's label, e.g. 'Sign out', 'Clear'.

on.description: Whether it is on, if it is turned on or off.

sections.description: The groups, each under a short heading.

links.description: What is inside, e.g. 'Send feedback', 'Privacy statement', 'Terms of use'.

app.description: The app's name as its title bar shows it, one or two words.

page.description: The page's title, at most four words: what this place in the app is called, e.g. 'Inbox', 'Library', 'Orders', 'Settings'; one thing's name only when the page is about that one thing. A dialog's title is its question, e.g. 'Delete this file?'; a document's is its file name, e.g. 'Untitled.txt'.

items.description: The app's sections, in the order the navigation lists them.

active.description: Index of the section this page is in.

title.description: What changed, in a few words, e.g. 'You're offline', 'Update available'.

message.description: One sentence: what it means, or what to do about it.

action.description: The label of a button, if there is one thing to do, e.g. 'Retry', 'Install', 'Renew'.

commands.description: The commands, in order of importance, each a single word where it can be, e.g. 'New', 'Delete', 'Share', 'Sort'.

columns.description: The column headings, the record's name first, e.g. 'Name', 'Date modified', 'Type', 'Size'.

items.description: Short: a name, a date, a number with its unit, a word of status.

cells.description: One value for each column, in the columns' order.

rows.description: The records, one to a row.
